_comment: TEMPLATE — do not edit this file directly. Copy it to firebase-service-account.json in this same directory and replace with the real key.
_instructions: 1. Firebase console → panasa-cms-ad3f9 project → Project settings (gear icon) → Service accounts tab
2. Click 'Generate new private key' — this downloads a JSON file
3. Rename/copy that file to firebase-service-account.json in this directory (dev/api/ and prod/api/)
5. Verify it's blocked from public access: curl https://www.panasatech.com/api/firebase-service-account.json -> should return 403

6. In the Firebase console, go to Storage -> Rules and make sure the uploads/ path allows public read (write/delete stay locked down since the server uploads via this service account, which bypasses Security Rules):
